regions.model_scope: Katy ISD independent 2024–25 original published-rate grade-school models use exact CCD LEA 4825170 / TX-101914 / TAPR 101914. All 65 positive native enrolled grades 3–8 and explicit-zero grades 9–12 profiles remain searchable. Harris 101914033 retains both original subject masks, leaving 64 observations in each separate Math, ELA and own Combined model. Own CPNTALLC enrollment supplies the individual income denominator; CPETALLC membership remains separate. Miller 101914004 and Project Tyke 101914135 lack native records and stay outside. Valid-score counts, the ten-valid-scored floor, variances and sampling intervals remain unavailable; high, mixed, Future and unmatched populations stay separate.
